pinned_native_image_reference.scope: Explicit 2026-11-23 baseline decision: Official Apple Pkl 0.32.0 prebuilt native-image binaries (pkl and pkldoc, SHA-256 pinned in oracle.lock.json) are the primary <= 1.00x execution time and os.wait4 peak RSS strict gate for all 15 CLI, server, and pkldoc workloads (cold-cli and steady-server). Live Temurin 21.0.13.1+2-LTS and archived M0 GraalVM CE 25.0.1 remain recorded separately, and all 19 embedded API and JS/Wasm workloads remain strictly gated against pinned JVM (plus the 2026-11-22 browser Wasm contract) because official native-image ships CLI executables only.
